title: IK Retargeting - 5.4 Features at a Glance
description: This is an overview of new IK Rig & IK Retargeting features that have been added to Unreal Engine 5.4. These include Auto Retargeting, Post Retarget Phase, QOL, and more. IK Rig & IK Retargeting is Unreal Engine’s retargeting system, a powerful toolset to let you craft robust retargeting setups for any types of characters with different skeletal hierarchies.
